title: chrysanthemum fontanesii
intro: Chrysanthemum fontanesii, commonly known as the Korean chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, headache, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum fontanesii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as calming the mind and body, and reducing fever and inflammation.
